instruction: I need to convert the music video on my desktop to an audio file. Use VLC to extract the audio and save it as "Baby Justin Bieber.mp3" on the desktop in MP3 format.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting audio from video using VLC and saving in MP3 format. Evaluator uses 'file' command to verify the output is actually an MP3/MPEG audio file, not just a file with .mp3 extension. This ensures correct format conversion.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly uses file command to verify actual file format (not just extension)
Metric correctly compares is_mp3 boolean with expected value
Evaluator verifies both file existence and correct MP3 format
Expected parameter handling is correct (directly accesses is_mp3 from expected dict)
Detection logic is robust: checks for audio AND (mpeg OR mp3 OR layer iii) in file type output
Complete coverage: verifies the core requirement that output file is actually in MP3 format
